chapter: Package shows, Miami and the USO
title: Touring with Alberta Hunter and her purse
summary: A story of Hunter's careful hoarding of cash and a missing purse in Paris.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: One of the dog gonest things that happened--
How did you come to pick Alberta? Was she already assigned?
She's done a lot of USO.

They asked me if it was all right and I said of course. She was much older than the girls that I had, but that was all right with me. I had no trouble with her and we had a rough tour. She did her work.

She's as cheap as a nickel whistle, she's got every nickel she ever made and a little story that goes along with all the hard knocks we had, most of the guys got their money, they would get twenty five or thirty dollars and the rest of the money was here for them when they got back and she insisted on getting all of her money; she just liked to pat it. I kept telling her you shouldn't walk around with a thousand dollars and all that, but she just loved it.
We got into Paris and I persuaded

her to go down and get some traveler's checks. So we got in the cab and got out of the cab at American Express, we made about four steps and she screamed, oh, my purse, my purse is in the cab and I ran and screamed and screamed, and I know this guy thought I wish I never stopped for that guy, he heard me and stopped.
You had to make arrangements on her numbers, I assume.
